messages.message: Quarterfinals are set: Defending champions Argentina, former winners France, Spain, and England, and first-time hopefuls Belgium, Morocco, Norway, and Switzerland make up the final eight.
messages.messageZh: 四分之一决赛席位已定：卫冕冠军阿根廷，前冠军法国、西班牙和英格兰，以及首次冲击冠军的比利时、摩洛哥、挪威和瑞士组成八强。
messages.emphasisZh: 四分之一决赛席位已定
